title: Semaglutide vs Tirzepatide
summary: Semaglutide: tier approved label, 6,039 indexed publications, 305 randomized trials. Tirzepatide: tier approved label, 2,756 indexed publications, 131 randomized trials. 5 indexed studies compare them directly; the head-to-head section quotes what they state.

seo.title: Semaglutide vs Tirzepatide: what the studies show
seo.description: Semaglutide vs Tirzepatide, side by side from each compound's own cited record, plus any direct head-to-head trial. Not advice.

head_to_head.value: Phase 3 clinical trial, humans, 2026: This study evaluated the cost-effectiveness (from the United States [US] societal perspective) of tirzepatide at its maximum-tolerated-dose (MTD) compared to semaglutide (MTD), both administered adjunct to a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity.
head_to_head.source_excerpt: This study evaluated the cost-effectiveness (from the United States [US] societal perspective) of tirzepatide at its maximum-tolerated-dose (MTD) compared to semaglutide (MTD), both administered adjunct to a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity.

head_to_head.value: Human study, humans, n=376, 2026: Among 553 073 adults with at least one semaglutide ( n = 376 697) or tirzepatide ( n = 176 376) prescription and baseline weight availability, documented initiation within ±3 months of the first structured prescription was identified in 141 189 semaglutide patients and 62 040 tirzepatide patients.

head_to_head.value: Clinical trial, humans, 2026: Patients treated with tirzepatide lost more weight than those treated with semaglutide (mean reduction, 14.7 vs. 10.8%; P P < 0.001), accompanied by faster monthly weight-loss velocity (2.54 vs. 2.18%).

head_to_head.value: Human study, humans, n=920, 2026: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists demonstrate cardiovascular benefits; however, head-to-head comparisons between semaglutide and tirzepatide remain limited.

head_to_head.value: Animal study, mice, 2026: Given the therapeutic potential of GLP-1 receptor agonists (semaglutide, tirzepatide, and retatrutide) in diabetic nephropathy, we evaluated their anti-fibrotic and anti-inflammatory effects in non-diabetic renal fibrosis using HK-2 cells and murine UUO and aging models.
